description: Fetch the event agenda: sessions and networking blocks with times. Use get_session for one session's details and my_schedule for your personal schedule. Resolves the menu path automatically; pass path to override.

event.description: B2match event URL, slug/euid, or numeric event id.

path.description: Optional event menu path (e.g. /components/<id>) from get_event navigation; omit to resolve it automatically.

name: get_agenda
title: Get B2match agenda
